title: Retrieve & Re-Rank — Sentence Transformers documentation (sbert.net)
key_points: 官方文档将检索架构描述为两阶段 Retrieve & Re-Rank 流水线：第一阶段检索系统返回约 100 个候选，第二阶段用 CrossEncoder 重排。
bi-encoder 的定义：检索阶段可用 lexical search（如 Elasticsearch）或 dense retrieval，后者用 SentenceTransformer 实现，文档中明确称其为 "a.k.a. bi-encoder"。
bi-encoder 的计算范式：为段落和查询「独立」生成 embedding（"produces embeddings independently for your paragraphs and for your search queries"），再用向量相似度（cosine-similarity）比较。
cross-encoder 的打分机制：query 与候选 document 被「同时」送入 transformer 网络，网络输出 0 到 1 之间的单一分数，表示该文档对给定查询的相关性。
cross-encoder 的优势来源被明确归因于「跨 query 与 document 做 attention」（"they perform attention across the query and the document"），因此性能更高。
cross-encoder 的适用边界：对成千上万乃至上百万个 (query, document) 对逐一打分「会相当慢」（"Scoring thousands or millions of (query, document)-pairs would be rather slow"），故只用于对检索器产出的约 100 个候选做重排。
retriever 的适用边界：必须对含数百万条目的文档集合保持高效，但可能返回不相关候选，这正是需要 re-ranker 的原因。
文档给出 cross-encoder 的例外用法：当段落集合很小（如单文档内搜索）时可跳过检索阶段，直接用 cross-encoder 对查询与全部段落打分。
语义检索（dense retrieval）相对 lexical search 的优势：lexical search 只做查询词的字面匹配，无法识别同义词、缩写或拼写变体；语义检索将查询编码进向量空间并取邻近文档 embedding。

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks (EMNLP 2019)
key_points: 论文指出 BERT/RoBERTa 用于句子对回归任务（如 STS）时要求「两个句子同时输入网络」，由此带来巨大的计算开销。
给出 cross-encoder 式全交叉打分的复杂度量级：在 10,000 个句子中找最相似的一对需要约 5000 万次推理计算（约 65 小时）。
SBERT 采用 siamese 与 triplet 网络结构，产出可用 cosine-similarity 比较的语义句子 embedding。
复杂度改善幅度：找最相似对的时间从 BERT/RoBERTa 的 65 小时降至 SBERT 的约 5 秒，同时保持 BERT 的准确率。
论文明确结论：BERT 的构造方式使其不适合语义相似度搜索以及聚类等无监督任务。
该文发表于 EMNLP 2019。

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering (DPR)
key_points: 论文指出开放域问答依赖高效段落检索来选取候选上下文，TF-IDF / BM25 等稀疏向量空间模型是此前的事实标准方法。
DPR 证明检索可仅用稠密表示实际实现，embedding 由「简单的 dual-encoder 框架」从少量问题与段落中学习得到。
效果：在广泛的开放域 QA 数据集上，稠密检索器在 top-20 段落检索准确率上较强 Lucene-BM25 系统大幅领先 9%-19% 绝对值。
该稠密检索器帮助端到端 QA 系统在多个开放域 QA 基准上取得新的 state-of-the-art。

title: Passage Re-ranking with BERT (monoBERT)
key_points: 论文将工作定位为「BERT 用于基于查询的段落重排（query-based passage re-ranking）」的一次简单复现。
该重排系统在 TREC-CAR 数据集上为 state of the art，并在 MS MARCO passage retrieval 任务排行榜上位列第一。
相对此前 state of the art，在 MRR@10 上取得 27% 的相对提升。
论文提供复现代码于 https://github.com/nyu-dl/dl4marco-bert。

title: Retrieve & Re-Rank — Sentence Transformers documentation
key_points: RAG/QA 检索采用两阶段 pipeline：第一阶段 retrieval 先取回约 100 个候选（可用 Elasticsearch 等词法检索，或用 SentenceTransformer 即 bi-encoder 做稠密检索），第二阶段用基于 CrossEncoder 的 re-ranker 对候选打分重排。
reranker 处于 first-stage retrieval 之后、结果呈现/下游使用之前，其输入是检索器已召回的候选集，因此 reranker 只能重排、不能召回 first-stage 未取回的文档（recall 上限由第一阶段候选集决定）。
文档明确指出第一阶段检索器「可能返回与查询并不那么相关的文档」（might retrieve documents that are not that relevant），这正是引入 reranker 的直接动因。
CrossEncoder 将 query 与单个 document 同时输入同一个 transformer，跨 query-document 做 attention，输出 0–1 的单一相关性分数。
CrossEncoder 精度更高但代价大：对成千上万乃至上百万个 (query, document) 对逐一打分「会相当慢」（rather slow），因此必须先用检索器把候选集缩到约 100 个再重排。
词法检索只做查询词的字面匹配，无法识别同义词、缩写或拼写变体；稠密检索（bi-encoder）把 query 编码进向量空间取近邻，可覆盖同义词与缩写——即两类 first-stage 检索器各有不同的失效模式。
bi-encoder 对段落和查询分别独立生成 embedding，因此文档向量可离线预计算并索引，这是其能支撑百万级集合的原因。
官方示例流程：把 Wikipedia 文章切分为段落并用 bi-encoder 编码，查询时取余弦相似度最高的段落，再由 CrossEncoder 重排，最终把 CrossEncoder 分数最高的 5 个段落呈现给用户。
当段落集合很小时（如单文档内搜索）可跳过 retrieval 阶段，直接用 CrossEncoder 对全部段落打分。
raw_excerpt: Given a search query, we first use a retrieval system that retrieves a large list of e.g. 100 possible hits which are potentially relevant for the query. ... However, the retrieval system might retrieve documents that are not that relevant for the search query. Hence, in a second stage, we use a re-ranker based on a CrossEncoder that scores the relevancy of all candidates for the given search query. ... The advantage of Cross-Encoders is the higher performance, as they perform attention across the query and the document. Scoring thousands or millions of (query, document)-pairs would be rather slow. Hence, we use the retriever to create a set of e.g. 100 possible candidates which are then re-ranked by the Cross-Encoder.

title: How Rerank Works — Cohere Rerank API documentation
key_points: Cohere Rerank 的接口形态是：给定一个 query 和一个 documents 列表，返回按与 query 语义相关性从高到低排序的文档索引及 relevance_score。
该接口是「对已有候选文档列表重排」，即 reranker 工作在检索之后的排序阶段，不负责从全库召回。
官方示例中，对「美国首都是哪里」的查询，包含 Washington, D.C. 的文档被排到第 1 位（relevance_score 0.943264），而字面含 capital 但语义无关的「Capital punishment in the US」被排到最后（0.4664567）——体现 reranker 能压制关键词命中但语义无关的候选。
文档建议结构化文档以 YAML 字符串形式传入 reranker 以获得最佳效果。
计费单位中包含 search_units（示例中为 1.0），说明 rerank 调用按搜索单元计费。
该页面为 API 使用文档，未提供 nDCG/recall 提升幅度或延迟基准数据。

title: Milvus 官方文档 — Reranking（hybrid search 中的重排阶段）
key_points: Milvus 通过 hybrid_search() API 在多个 AnnSearchRequest 结果之上执行 reranking，官方文档称 reranking 是整合多个向量字段结果、决定最终排序的关键步骤。
Milvus 原生提供的 rerank 策略只有两种：WeightedRanker（对不同向量检索路径的分数做加权平均）与 RRFRanker（基于各路径排名的倒数排名融合）。
WeightedRanker 流程：收集各路径分数 → 用 arctan 将不同度量（IP 为 [-∞,+∞]、L2 为 [0,+∞]）的分数归一化到 [0,1] → 按用户给定权重（0~1）加权平均 → 排序；权重个数须等于 AnnSearchRequest 个数。
RRFRanker 公式中平滑参数 k 默认 60，可显式指定（示例 k=100）；适用于各字段重要性无明确先验的场景。
文档中描述的 rerank 阶段属于分数/排名融合层，未涉及神经 cross-encoder 模型推理。
raw_excerpt: Reranking in hybrid search is a crucial step that consolidates results from several vector fields, ensuring the final output is relevant and accurately prioritized. Currently, Milvus offers these reranking strategies: WeightedRanker ... RRFRanker ... Here, 𝑁 represents the number of different retrieval routes, rank𝑖(𝑑) is the rank position of retrieved document 𝑑 by the 𝑖th retriever, and 𝑘 is a smoothing parameter, typically set to 60.

title: BEIR: A Heterogenous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models (arXiv:2104.08663v4)
key_points: BEIR 由 18 个公开文本检索数据集构成，覆盖多种任务与领域，用于零样本（out-of-distribution）检索评测。
论文评测了 10 个检索系统，涵盖 lexical、sparse、dense、late-interaction 与 re-ranking 五类架构。
论文结论：BM25 是稳健的基线；re-ranking 与 late-interaction 类模型平均取得最佳零样本性能，但计算成本高。
论文结论：dense 与 sparse 检索模型计算效率更高，但常常不如上述方法，说明其泛化能力仍有较大提升空间。
该来源为 NeurIPS 2021 Dataset and Benchmark Track 接收论文。
raw_excerpt: Our results show BM25 is a robust baseline and re-ranking and late-interaction-based models on average achieve the best zero-shot performances, however, at high computational costs. In contrast, dense and sparse-retrieval models are computationally more efficient but often underperform other approaches, highlighting the considerable room for improvement in their generalization capabilities.

title: Speeding up Inference — Sentence Transformers documentation (Cross Encoder)
key_points: Sentence Transformers 为 Cross Encoder 推理提供 3 种后端：PyTorch（默认）、ONNX、OpenVINO（主要面向 Intel 硬件），各自有不同优化。
若不指定 device，CrossEncoder 会自动选择 "cuda"、"mps"、"cpu" 中最强的可用选项。
GPU 上可用 float16 (fp16) 半精度加速推理，官方描述为「以极小的精度损失换取 GPU 推理加速」；bf16 与 fp16 类似但保留更多 fp32 原始精度。
官方明确不推荐对 Cross Encoder 启用 Flash Attention 2：因为让 Flash Attention 发挥优势的自动 input unpadding 只适用于 feature-extraction 任务，classification head 与 flattened inputs 不兼容。
官方基准测得：在没有 unpadding 的情况下，单纯替换 kernel 在长文本上与 fp16 速度持平，在短文本上慢 20% 到 45%，该结论覆盖全部四个被基准测试的 reranker。
torch.compile 的收益强烈依赖模型与硬件：收益随模型规模增大而增大；非常小的模型在快 GPU 上可能收益很小甚至略微变慢，因为其推理主要受 tokenization 与 Python 开销支配。
mode="reduce-overhead" 会应用 CUDA graphs 以消除主导 batch-size-1 推理的 per-kernel launch 开销；但 CUDA graphs 每个输入 shape 捕获一张图，因此需要稳定 shape（需把输入 padding 到接近典型长度的固定长度）。
文档正文设有 "Benchmarks" 小节（标题为「Benchmarks for the different backends」），指向不同后端的基准数据。
CrossEncoder 的标准调用方式是对 (query, passage) 成对打分：scores = model.predict([(query, passage) for passage in passages])，即每个候选都需一次完整的前向计算。
raw_excerpt: Sentence Transformers supports 3 backends for performing inference with Cross Encoder models, each with its own optimizations for speeding up inference: PyTorch / ONNX / OpenVINO ... However, we do not currently recommend it for Cross Encoder models: the automatic input unpadding that makes Flash Attention shine for Sentence Transformer and Multi-Vector Encoder models only applies to the feature-extraction task, as classification heads are incompatible with flattened inputs. Without unpadding, our benchmarks measured the bare kernel swap at equal speed to fp16 on long texts and 20 to 45% slower on short texts, across all four benchmarked rerankers. ... Whether it helps depends strongly on the model and hardware: the benefit grows with model size, and very small models on a fast GPU can see little gain or even a slight slowdown, since their inference is dominated by tokenization and Python overhead.

title: GroupRank: A Groupwise Paradigm for Effective and Efficient Passage Reranking with LLMs
key_points: 论文明确把当前 LLM reranking 的困境表述为 efficiency-accuracy trade-off：pointwise 方法高效但忽略文档间比较、精度次优；listwise 方法能捕捉全局上下文，但受上下文窗口限制且推理延迟过高（prohibitive inference latency）。
提出 groupwise 折中范式 GroupRank，用融合局部 pointwise 信号与全局 listwise 排序的无答案数据合成流程，配合 SFT 与 RL（group-ranking reward 含 ranking-utility 与 group-alignment 两部分）。
在 BRIGHT 上取得 65.2 NDCG@10，称其为 state-of-the-art（该 SOTA 主张出自作者自述，未见第三方复现）。
在 R2MED 上超过基线 2.1 个点，同时带来 6.4 倍推理加速（speedup 相对何基线、硬件与 batch 配置未在摘要中说明）。
raw_excerpt: current LLM-based reranking paradigms are fundamentally constrained by an efficiency-accuracy trade-off: (1) pointwise methods are efficient but ignore inter-document comparison, yielding suboptimal accuracy; (2) listwise methods capture global context but suffer from context-window constraints and prohibitive inference latency. ... Experimental results show GroupRank achieves a state-of-the-art 65.2 NDCG@10 on BRIGHT and surpasses baselines by 2.1 points on R2MED, while delivering a 6.4$\times$ inference speedup.

title: ERank: Fusing Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning for Effective and Efficient Text Reranking
key_points: 论文指出 LLM reranker 存在根本性权衡：基于 SFT 的 pointwise 方法把相关性当作二分类任务，缺乏必要的打分区分度（尤其对基于 reasoning LLM 的模型）；而为复杂推理设计的方法多采用强大但低效的 listwise 形式，使其在低延迟应用中不可行（impractical for low latency applications）。
提出 ERank：基于 reasoning LLM 的 pointwise reranker，两阶段训练——先 SFT 生成细粒度整数分数（而非二分类标签）以提升相关性区分度，再用源自 listwise 的 reward 做 RL，把全局排序意识注入高效的 pointwise 架构。
在 BRIGHT、FollowIR、TREC DL、BEIR 上评测；ERank-4B 在 BRIGHT 上 nDCG@10 为 38.7，32B 变体达到 40.2 的 nDCG@10（作者称 state of the art，属自述主张）。
该工作代表 2025 年的一条主流路线：不放弃 pointwise 的低延迟架构，而是用 listwise 派生的监督/奖励信号弥补 pointwise 缺少文档间比较的缺陷。
raw_excerpt: current Large Language Models (LLMs) powered rerankers often face a fundamental trade-off. On one hand, Supervised Fine-Tuning based pointwise methods that frame relevance as a binary classification task lack the necessary scoring discrimination ... On the other hand, approaches designed for complex reasoning often employ powerful yet inefficient listwise formulations, rendering them impractical for low latency applications. ... our ERank-4B achieves an nDCG@10 of 38.7, while a larger 32B variant reaches a state of the art nDCG@10 of 40.2.

title: EviRerank: Adaptive Evidence Construction for Long-Document LLM Reranking
key_points: 指出 decoder-only LLM reranker 处理长文档时推理代价高（inference is costly），且相关性信号会被无关上下文稀释；注意力分析显示追加非相关文本时存在一致的性能退化趋势。
EviRerank 先用轻量 selector（BM25、bi-encoder 或 cross-encoder）给文档块打分，再在硬性 token 上限下用 Adaptive Evidence Budgeting 动态分配证据块预算、并用 Summary Augmentation 加入全局摘要线索，最后由 decoder-only LLM 重排。
在 TREC DL'19、DL'22、DL'23 与 MLDR-zh 上一致优于 full-document LLM reranking 与强 block-selection 基线，同时大幅缩短输入长度；TREC DL'19 上 nDCG@10 最高达 0.744，并显著降低 reranking 延迟。
补充的 RankZephyr-7B 实验确认在匹配上下文预算下该方法可迁移到 listwise reranking，说明 cross-encoder/bi-encoder 预筛 + LLM 重排的级联结构对 listwise 同样适用。
raw_excerpt: Decoder-only LLM rerankers struggle with long documents: inference is costly and relevance signals can be diluted by irrelevant context. ... EviRerank (i) scores document blocks with a lightweight selector (BM25, bi-encoder, or cross-encoder) ... On TREC DL'19, EviRerank reaches up to 0.744 nDCG@10 while substantially reducing reranking latency. Additional RankZephyr-7B experiments confirm transfer to listwise reranking under matched context budgets.

title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Its Promise and Limitations
key_points: 论文指出 LLM 用于推荐重排会引入推荐质量与 serving efficiency 之间的重要权衡（trade-off between recommendation quality and serving efficiency）。
在三个 Amazon Reviews 领域、四种候选集规模上，把两个决策导向系统（TypeSafe Jev、OpenAI Decisions）与推荐专用模型以及 pointwise 和 listwise 的 LLM reranker 做受控对比，系统评估推荐效果、候选顺序鲁棒性、效率与可扩展性。
结果显示 Jev 常能取得较优的质量-延迟权衡：以显著低于更强 LLM 替代方案的实测延迟（substantially lower observed latency）提供有竞争力的推荐效果。
结论强调针对决策任务的专门化并不必然带来更优的推荐质量或鲁棒性，决策导向推理的实际价值取决于实现细节与应用需求——即 listwise LLM 重排并非在所有场景都值得其延迟成本。
raw_excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important trade-off between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. ... we compare these systems against recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise LLM-based rerankers, systematically evaluating recommendation effectiveness, candidate-order robustness, and efficiency and scalability. ... Jev frequently achieves a favorable quality--latency trade-off, offering competitive recommendation effectiveness at substantially lower observed latency than stronger LLM-based alternatives.

title: Practical RAG Evaluation: A Rarity-Aware Set-Based Metric and Cost-Latency-Quality Trade-offs
key_points: 论文主张经典以排序为中心的 IR 指标（nDCG/MAP/MRR）对 RAG 适配性差，因为 LLM 消费的是一个 passage 集合而非被浏览的列表，位置折扣与 prevalence-blind 聚合会漏掉关键点：cutoff K 处的 prompt 是否包含决定性证据。
提出 RA-nWG@K（rarity-aware、per-query 归一化的集合分数）以及 PROC / %PROC 两个操作上限指标，用于在 Cost-Latency-Quality（CLQ）视角下把检索侧与排序侧的可提升空间分离。
在面向生产 RAG（科学论文语料）的基准中覆盖 dense retrieval、hybrid dense+BM25、embedding 模型与维度、cross-encoder reranker、ANN（HNSW）与量化，给出实践者的 Pareto 指导。
其 rag-gs 流程采用 Plackett-Luce listwise refinement，报告迭代更新优于单次 LLM 排序（single-shot LLM ranking）。
raw_excerpt: Classical rank-centric IR metrics (nDCG/MAP/MRR) are a poor fit for RAG, where LLMs consume a set of passages rather than a browsed list ... a comprehensive benchmark on a production RAG (scientific-papers corpus) spanning dense retrieval, hybrid dense+BM25, embedding models and dimensions, cross-encoder rerankers, ANN (HNSW), and quantization ... rag-gs (MIT), a lean golden-set pipeline with Plackett-Luce listwise refinement whose iterative updates outperform single-shot LLM ranking

title: RankGround: Efficient High-Resolution GUI Grounding via Lightweight Reranker-Guided Crop Selection
key_points: 该工作虽属 GUI grounding 而非文本检索，但提供了 pointwise 与 listwise 目标在成本-精度上的直接对照：GroundRanker 采用两阶段课程训练，先以 pointwise 目标学习粗粒度包含关系，再用 listwise 目标细化视觉相似 crop 之间的细微语义与空间差异。
结果显示该组合在全部 backbone 上平均提升定位精度 5.5%，并实现 1.4 倍更快的推理（相对次优方法），即 pointwise 打底 + listwise 精排可在不牺牲延迟的前提下提升排序质量。
该来源仅作为 pointwise/listwise 组合策略的旁证，不能直接外推到文本 passage reranking 的 nDCG@10 结论。
raw_excerpt: GroundRanker is then trained with a two-stage curriculum: a pointwise objective first learns coarse containment, and a listwise objective refines subtle semantic and spatial distinctions among visually similar crops. Experimental results show RankGround consistently outperforms strong baselines while reducing computational cost. It achieves 1.4 times faster inference and improves localization accuracy by 5.5% on average over the second-best method

title: PLAID: An Efficient Engine for Late Interaction Retrieval
key_points: PLAID 通过 centroid interaction（把每个 passage 视为轻量 centroid 袋）与 centroid pruning（稀疏化 centroid 袋）两种机制加速 late interaction 检索。
论文声称在不影响检索质量的前提下，相对 vanilla ColBERTv2 将 late interaction 搜索延迟最多降低 7×（GPU）与 45×（CPU）。
在该加速下，ColBERTv2 + PLAID 在 GPU 上达到数十毫秒级延迟，CPU 上为数十至数百毫秒级，评测规模最大到 1.4 亿（140M）passages。
论文将 late interaction（ColBERT，经 ColBERTv2 改进）描述为在多项基准上处于 state-of-the-art 地位的检索范式。
raw_excerpt: PLAID uses centroid interaction as well as centroid pruning, a mechanism for sparsifying the bag of centroids, within a highly-optimized engine to reduce late interaction search latency by up to 7× on a GPU and 45× on a CPU against vanilla ColBERTv2, while continuing to deliver state-of-the-art retrieval quality. This allows the PLAID engine with ColBERTv2 to achieve latency of tens of milliseconds on a GPU and tens or just few hundreds of milliseconds on a CPU at large scale, even at the largest scales we evaluate with 140M passages.

title: Jina-ColBERT-v2: A General-Purpose Multilingual Late Interaction Retriever
key_points: 论文明确把 ColBERT 的 late interaction 打分定位为「近似 cross-encoder 的 query-document 联合注意力」，同时因 bi-encoder 架构与近期索引/搜索优化而保持接近传统稠密检索的推理效率。
该工作对 ColBERT 架构与训练流程提出若干增量改进，借鉴更成熟的单向量 embedding 训练范式，重点针对异构多语言数据与效率提升。
发布 Jina-ColBERT-v2 模型，在英语与多语言检索任务上评测；论文为 8 页，EMNLP workshop 投稿，v1 提交于 2024-08-29，v4 修订于 2024-09-14。
raw_excerpt: ColBERT's late interaction scoring approximates the joint query-document attention seen in cross-encoders while maintaining inference efficiency closer to traditional dense retrieval models, thanks to its bi-encoder architecture and recent optimizations in indexing and search.

title: lightonai/pylate — Flexible Training and Retrieval for Late Interaction Models
key_points: PyLate 是构建在 Sentence Transformers 之上的库，用于简化 ColBERT 类 late interaction 模型的微调、推理与检索。
支持单 GPU 与多 GPU 微调，并可从多数预训练语言模型构建 ColBERT 模型（非 ColBERT 模型会自动加一层线性层）。
训练路径包括对比学习（Contrastive / CachedContrastive 损失，配合 GradCache 以在有限显存下模拟更大 batch）与知识蒸馏（用强 teacher 模型分数训练 ColBERT）。
README 指出对比学习中温度参数极为重要，文献常用约 0.02。
仓库热度：约 899 stars、95 forks，最近一次 push 为 2026-07-23。
raw_excerpt: PyLate is a library built on top of Sentence Transformers, designed to simplify and optimize fine-tuning, inference, and retrieval with state-of-the-art ColBERT models. It enables easy fine-tuning on both single and multiple GPUs... To get the best performance when training a ColBERT model, you should use knowledge distillation to train the model using the scores of a strong teacher model.

title: AnswerDotAI/RAGatouille — late-interaction (ColBERT) retrieval in RAG pipelines
key_points: RAGatouille 定位为在任意 RAG pipeline 中便捷使用与训练 late-interaction（ColBERT）检索方法的工具，强调模块化与易用性，并称由研究支撑。
仓库热度：约 3972 stars、279 forks，最近一次 push 为 2025-05-17，是 late interaction 方案在 RAG 工程侧热度最高的代表仓库之一。
raw_excerpt: Easily use and train state of the art late-interaction retrieval methods (ColBERT) in any RAG pipeline. Designed for modularity and ease-of-use, backed by research.

title: M3-Embedding: Multi-Linguality, Multi-Functionality, Multi-Granularity Text Embeddings Through Self-Knowledge Distillation
key_points: 该论文提出 M3-Embedding，支持 100 多种语言的稠密检索、多向量检索与稀疏检索三种检索功能，输入粒度覆盖短句到最长 8192 token 的长文档。
论文提出一种 self-knowledge distillation 方法，将不同检索功能产生的相关性分数整合为 teacher signal 用于训练。
论文优化了 batching 策略以支持大 batch size 与高训练吞吐。
该论文是 BAAI/bge 系列（含 bge-reranker-v2 系列）的技术母论文，但摘要层面未给出 reranker 蒸馏后的 nDCG 保持率、参数量或延迟数字。
raw_excerpt: we propose a novel self-knowledge distillation approach, where the relevance scores from different retrieval functionalities can be integrated as the teacher signal to enhance the training quality. We also optimize the batching strategy, which enables a large batch size and high training throughput to improve the discriminativeness of embeddings.

title: DocReRank: Single-Page Hard Negative Query Generation for Training Multi-Modal RAG Rerankers
key_points: 该文指出 reranker 通常用 hard negative mining 训练，目标是选出对每个 query 排名高但实际不相关的页面。
该文认为传统 hard negative mining 是被动的、受限于检索器在现有语料中能找到的内容，存在四个固有局限：多样性有限、负例常常不够 hard、可控性低、以及频繁的 false negative 损害训练。
该文提出反向做法 Single-Page Hard Negative Query Generation：不按 query 检索负例页面，而是按页面生成 hard negative query。
具体做法是用自动化 LLM-VLM 流水线，给定一个页面及其正例 query，通过改写 query 使其在形式与上下文上尽可能相似、但无法从该页面得到答案，从而构造 hard negative。
该文称该范式可对生成 query 做细粒度控制，得到多样、hard、有针对性的负例，并支持高效的 false negative 验证。
该文报告用该方法生成数据训练的 reranker 优于现有模型并显著提升检索性能（摘要为定性表述，未给出具体分数）。
raw_excerpt: Rerankers are typically trained using hard negative mining, whose goal is to select pages for each query which rank high, but are actually irrelevant. However, this selection process is typically passive and restricted to what the retriever can find in the available corpus, leading to several inherent limitations. These include: limited diversity, negative examples which are often not hard enough, low controllability, and frequent false negatives which harm training. ... Instead of retrieving negative pages per query, we generate hard negative queries per page.

title: ReasonIR: Training Retrievers for Reasoning Tasks
key_points: 该文提出 ReasonIR-8B，自称是首个专门面向通用推理任务训练的 retriever。
该文认为现有 retriever 在推理任务上增益有限，部分原因是现有训练数据集中于短事实型 query，且对应文档能直接给出答案。
该文构建了合成数据生成流水线：对每个文档生成一个具有挑战性且相关的 query，同时生成一个看似相关但最终无用的 hard negative。
该文称训练数据为合成数据与现有公开数据的混合（摘要截断处为 'existing pu...'，混合的具体构成未能读到）。
raw_excerpt: We develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that, for each document, our pipeline creates a challenging and relevant query, along with a plausibly related but ultimately unhelpful hard negative. By training on a mixture of our synthetic data and existing pu[blic data]...

title: PETRA: Transforming Web Text for Petroleum-Engineering Domain Adaptation
key_points: PETRA 是一个面向石油工程领域的大规模数据集与流水线，把噪声公开网页数据转成精选领域语料，并为 dense retrieval 与 reranking 生成合成监督信号。
数据规模：1.36M 精选 chunks、约 2B token 等量、约 859k 条 embedding 训练行（来自约 224k 个 anchor）、约 400k 条 teacher 打分的 reranker 候选行。
构造流程包含：高召回能源领域语料筛选、测试准确率 98.4% 的能源领域分类器、基于 chunk 的 query 生成、LLM 撰写的 hard negative、以及检索挖掘的候选列表。
报告增益：通过 score fusion 将第一阶段域内 nDCG 从 0.703 提升到 0.763。
报告增益：reranker 适配使公开 Earth Science 基准相对提升 44%，使六任务 reasoning-intensive 面板相对提升 23%。
该文报告负面发现：在合成标签上取得高 train-holdout 准确率并不能预测检索增益；检索挖掘的数据只有在被重新打包为从推理时候选分布中采样的 teacher 打分候选列表后才有帮助。
raw_excerpt: PETRA contains 1.36M curated chunks, approximately 2B token equivalents, $\approx$859k, embedding training rows from $\approx$224k anchors, and roughly 400k teacher-scored reranker candidate rows. ... PETRA improves first-stage in-domain Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (nDCG) from 0.703 to 0.763 through score fusion. Reranker adaptation improves the public Earth Science benchmark by 44% relative and a six-task reasoning-intensive panel by 23%. Failed training recipes show that high train-holdout accuracy on synthetic labels does not predict retrieval gains.

title: Enhancing Transformer-Based Rerankers with Synthetic Data and LLM-Based Supervision
key_points: 该文提出一条无需人工标注 query-document 对的流水线，用于微调较小的 transformer reranker。
方法：用 LLM 从领域语料生成合成 query，再用基于 LLM 的分类器标注 positive 与 hard-negative 对。
该合成数据集用于以 Localized Contrastive Estimation (LCE) loss 做对比学习，微调较小的 transformer 模型。
在 MedQuAD 数据集上，该方法显著提升域内性能，并对域外任务有良好泛化（摘要为定性表述，未给出具体分数）。
该文主张把 LLM 用于数据生成与监督而非推理，可在保持较强 reranking 能力的同时降低计算成本。
该文被 RANLP 2025 接收。
raw_excerpt: Our method uses LLMs to generate synthetic queries from domain-specific corpora and employs an LLM-based classifier to label positive and hard-negative pairs. This synthetic dataset is then used to fine-tune a smaller transformer model with contrastive learning using Localized Contrastive Estimation (LCE) loss. Experiments on the MedQuAD dataset show that our approach significantly boosts in-domain performance and generalizes well to out-of-domain tasks.

title: LexPath: A domain-oriented multi-path framework for legal article retrieval
key_points: LexPath 是面向法律条文检索的领域多路框架，包含多路检索模块与意图感知 reranking 模块。
其检索模块含两条互补路径：IRAC 引导的稀疏路径（用法律信息性关键词扩展 query），以及用法律层级与引用关系导出的 hard negative 训练的结构引导稠密路径。
reranking 模块通过引入 query 与法律条文之间的意图兼容性来进一步精炼候选排序。
在三个中文基准上评测，并在一个日文基准上评估跨法域适用性；摘要称其在全部四个基准上一致优于 lexical、dense、hybrid 与 adaptive RAG 基线（未给出具体分数）。
该文被 EMNLP 2026 接收，代码与数据在 github.com/wxliuabigail/LexPath。
raw_excerpt: The retrieval module combines two complementary domain-specific paths to collect candidate articles: an IRAC-guided sparse path that expands queries with legally informative keywords, and a structure-guided dense path trained with hard negatives derived from legal hierarchy and citation relations. ... Experimental results demonstrate that LexPath consistently outperforms lexical, dense, hybrid, and adaptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines across all four benchmarks.

title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs (arXiv:2407.02485)
key_points: 提出 RankRAG 指令微调框架：用单个 LLM 同时承担 RAG 中的 context ranking 与 answer generation 双重用途。
关键发现：在训练混合数据中加入一小部分 ranking 数据即可让指令微调后的 LLM 在排序上表现很好，并超过现有专家排序模型，包括用 10 倍以上 ranking 数据专门微调的同一 LLM。
Llama3-RankRAG 在九个知识密集型基准上显著优于 Llama3-ChatQA-1.5 与 GPT-4 系列（GPT-4-0613、GPT-4-turbo-2024-0409）。
在五个生物医学领域 RAG 基准上，未用生物医学数据做指令微调的情况下表现与 GPT-4 相当，显示跨域泛化能力。
作者单位为 Georgia Tech 与 NVIDIA；v1 提交于 2024-07-02。
raw_excerpt: we propose a novel instruction fine-tuning framework RankRAG, which instruction-tunes a single LLM for the dual purpose of context ranking and answer generation in RAG. In particular, the instruction-tuned LLMs work surprisingly well by adding a small fraction of ranking data into the training blend, and outperform existing expert ranking models, including the same LLM exclusively fine-tuned on a large amount of ranking data.

title: RankRAG 全文（HTML 版）§1–§4：动机、两阶段指令微调与训练数据构成
key_points: 论文指出现有 RAG 流程三点局限：LLM 不擅长读过多 chunk（top-100），且更短的 top-k（如 5、10）通常带来更高生成准确率；小 k 下需机制保证召回；专家排序模型的零样本泛化能力弱于通用 LLM。
cross-encode 问题与候选上下文的独立排序模型，在从 top-N 候选中取 top-k（N≫k）时可比稠密 embedding 检索器效果更好——这是 reranker 在 RAG 中被需要的直接理由。
RankRAG 采用两阶段指令微调：Stage-I 为通用 SFT（共 128K 条样本，含 OpenAssistant、Dolly、SODA、ELI5、Self-Instruct、Unnatural Instructions、FLAN/CoT 等），Stage-II 为排序与生成的统一指令微调。
Stage-II 训练混合包含三类数据：排序数据、context-rich QA 数据（DROP、NarrativeQA、Quoref、ROPES、NewsQA、TAT-QA 及 ConvQA）、检索增强 QA 数据（SQuAD、WebQuestions，将 gold context 与 BM25 top 检索上下文混合共五个上下文，以提升对无关上下文的鲁棒性）。
论文在 related work 中说明：将检索器与 LLM 端到端联合优化需要 surrogate loss 且训练流程复杂，尤其当 embedding 模型更新导致向量库需频繁重建索引时；RankRAG 因此选择用单一 LLM 统一排序与生成，而非可微检索。
论文指出此前将排序用于 RAG 的方法仍依赖额外的中等规模模型（如 BERT、T5）做排序，难以充分刻画 query 与 context 的相关性且缺乏零样本泛化能力。
raw_excerpt: In practice, a separate ranking model (Nogueira et al., 2020; Glass et al., 2022; Ma et al., 2023) that cross-encodes question and candidate context can work better than a dense embedding-based retriever for obtaining the most relevant top-k contexts from top-N candidates (N ≫ k). ... However, this requires surrogate loss for optimization and complicates the training pipeline, especially when the embedding database needs to be re-indexed frequently due to the update of the embedding model (i.e., retriever).

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection (arXiv:2310.11511)
key_points: Self-RAG 训练单个任意 LM，按需自适应检索，并用特殊 token（reflection tokens）对检索到的段落及自身生成进行生成与反思。
reflection token 的生成使 LM 在推理阶段可控，可按不同任务需求定制行为（即把「是否相关/是否有支持」的判定内化进生成器，而非外挂独立 reranker）。
Self-RAG（7B 与 13B）在开放域 QA、推理与事实核查任务上优于 ChatGPT 与检索增强的 Llama2-chat，并在长文本生成的 factual 性与引用准确率上有显著提升。
论文 30 页、12 张表；v1 提交于 2023-10-17（早于本子问题 2024–2026 的时间窗，属该方向的奠基性前作）。
raw_excerpt: Our framework trains a single arbitrary LM that adaptively retrieves passages on-demand, and generates and reflects on retrieved passages and its own generations using special tokens, called reflection tokens. Generating reflection tokens makes the LM controllable during the inference phase ... Self-RAG (7B and 13B parameters) significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs and retrieval-augmented models on a diverse set of tasks.

title: LlamaIndex Docs — Node Postprocessor Modules (rerankers)
key_points: Node postprocessors run between retrieval and response synthesis: they take the nodes returned by a retriever and transform, filter, or re-order them before the LLM sees them; the most common kind is a reranker.

Local cross-encoder API is `llama_index.core.postprocessor.SentenceTransformerRerank`, constructed with `model` and `top_n` arguments, and it 'Uses the cross-encoders from the sentence-transformer package to re-order nodes, and returns the top N nodes.'
Hosted-API rerankers listed: CohereRerank (model 'rerank-v3.5'), JinaRerank (model 'jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual'), VoyageAIRerank, MixedbreadAIRerank, NVIDIARerank.
LLM-based rerankers listed: LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank, RankLLMRerank; token-level late interaction: ColbertRerank; multimodal: ColPaliRerank.

Official latency/quality guidance: 'No API key, local, recommended default: SentenceTransformerRerank ... Use cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 for speed, Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B for stronger multilingual quality.'
Official guidance for the slowest tier: 'Highest quality, latency tolerant: LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank, RankLLMRerank. These use an LLM itself to judge relevance.'

The constructor default model is `cross-encoder/stsb-distilroberta-base`, which the docs say was trained for semantic textual similarity rather than passage re-ranking; for retrieval they 'strongly recommend passing an MS MARCO-trained model like cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2'.
Swapping to Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B 'still runs locally with no API key, at the cost of extra compute per query compared to the MiniLM baselines.'

title: Elasticsearch Docs — Text similarity re-ranker retriever
key_points: The native rerank stage is the `text_similarity_reranker` retriever, which 'uses an NLP model to improve search results by reordering the top-k documents based on their semantic similarity to the query.'

Parameters: `retriever` (required child retriever producing the initial top documents), `field` (required document field compared against inference_text), `inference_id` (optional), `inference_text` (required), `rank_window_size` (optional), `min_score` (optional), `filter` (optional), `chunk_rescorer` (optional).
Default model backend: if no `inference_id` is given it defaults to the preconfigured `.rerank-v1-elasticsearch` endpoint, which uses the Elastic Rerank cross-encoder model (model_id `.rerank-v1`).

Supported alternative backends: Cohere Rerank inference endpoint with the `rerank` task type; Google Vertex AI inference endpoint with the `rerank` task type; or a Hugging Face model uploaded via Eland with `--task-type text_similarity` (example: `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2`).
Scale parameter: `rank_window_size` is 'The number of top documents to consider in the re-ranking process. Defaults to 10.'; the official examples set it to 100.

`chunk_rescorer` chunks and scores documents and 'only sends the best scoring chunks to the reranking model as input', which 'helps improve relevance when reranking long documents that would otherwise be truncated by the reranking model's token limit' and 'can also help to control costs by controlling the amount of tokens used for inference.'
Rerank scores are normalized before being returned: `score = max(score, 0) + min(exp(score), 1)`, with the documented inverse transform to recover raw scores.
The Elastic Rerank inference endpoint example uses adaptive allocations with `min_number_of_allocations: 1` and `max_number_of_allocations: 10`.

Defaults to 10. ... Scores from the re-ranking process are normalized using the following formula before returned to the user, to avoid having negative scores. score = max(score, 0) + min(exp(score), 1)

title: Elasticsearch Docs — Retrievers (rrf, linear, text_similarity_reranker overview)
key_points: `rrf` is listed as one of the available retrievers and 'produces top documents from reciprocal rank fusion (RRF)'; it is a separate retriever from `text_similarity_reranker`, which is described as enhancing results 'by re-ranking documents based on semantic similarity to a specified inference text, using a machine learning model.'

Retrievers form a tree: 'A retriever may have child retrievers where a retriever with two or more children is considered a compound retriever', which clarifies the order of operations during a search.

For compound retrievers, each child collects candidates up to its own `rank_window_size` limit, then the compound retriever computes final scores, then `min_score` filtering is applied: 'documents are filtered after the compound scoring has been applied.'
`from`/`size` are global and apply to all retrievers in the tree unless a retriever overrides size via a parameter such as `rank_window_size`, though final hits are always limited to `size`.
When a retriever is specified, top-level `query`, `knn`, `search_after`, `terminate_after`, `sort` are not allowed, and `rescore` must be replaced by a `rescorer` retriever.

When using min_score with compound retrievers (such as rrf or linear), documents are filtered after the compound scoring has been applied. ... Each child retriever collects documents up to its rank_window_size limit.

title: Vespa Docs — Ranking With Transformer Cross-Encoder Models
key_points: Vespa frames cross-encoders as ranking models rather than a separate reranker API: 'Cross-Encoder Transformer based text ranking models are generally more effective than text embedding models as they take both the query and the document as input with full cross-attention between all the query and document tokens.'
Vespa states the cost tradeoff explicitly: 'The downside of cross-encoder models is the computational complexity.'
Model backend is HuggingFace cross-encoders exported to ONNX with the Optimum library: `optimum-cli export onnx --task text-classification -m <model> ranker`.
Documented example models: `intfloat/simlm-msmarco-reranker` (BERT-based, English) and `BAAI/bge-reranker-base` (ROBERTa-based, English and Chinese / multilingual).
After export, two files are needed to import the model into Vespa: `model.onnx` and `tokenizer.json`.
The docs note the two example models use different language-model tokenization and different transformer inputs.

The downside of cross-encoder models is the computational complexity. This document is a guide on how to export cross-encoder Transformer based models from huggingface, and how to configure them for use in Vespa. ... $ optimum-cli export onnx --task text-classification -m intfloat/simlm-msmarco-reranker ranker

title: Vespa Docs — Phased Ranking
key_points: Vespa expresses the rerank stage declaratively in the schema's rank-profile, not via a dedicated reranker API: retrieval happens close to the data in content nodes, while ranking phases run in content nodes or in the stateless container after scatter-and-gather.

Per-node phases: `first-phase` (evaluated for all retrieved hits, can prune via `rank-score-drop-limit`), `second-phase` (optionally re-ranks top first-phase hits with a more complex expression), and `global-phase` (runs in the stateless container after merging top hits from content nodes).

Official scale default for the cross-encoder-style expensive phase: 'By default, second-phase ranking (if specified) is evaluated for the 100 best hits from the first-phase ranking per content node. The number that is reranked over all nodes can be set by total-rerank-count.'
Official latency rationale: second-phase 'enables more expensive computations than would be feasible to run as a first-phase computation, with predictable upper bounds for the cost.'

First-phase must stay cheap: its cost is bounded by the number of documents exposed to ranking on each content node times expression complexity, 'therefore the expression needs to be simple and cheap to allow scaling to large amounts of retrieved docs.'
`total-rerank-count` 'sets a strict upper bound on the number of documents that are re-ranked in total over the nodes.'
Customized reranking that is hard to express declaratively can be implemented as 'reranking in searcher'.

The number that is reranked over all nodes can be set by total-rerank-count. ... title: Voyage AI Docs — Reranker（模型选择与参数限制）
key_points: Voyage 官方将 reranker 定义为 cross-encoder：与分别编码 query 和 document 的 embedding 模型不同，reranker 联合处理 query-document 对，从而给出更准确的相关性预测。
Voyage 当前主力 reranker 为 rerank-3 与 rerank-3-lite，二者上下文长度均为 32,000 tokens。
rerank-2 的上下文长度为 16,000 tokens；rerank-2-lite 为 8,000 tokens；rerank-1 为 8,000 tokens；rerank-lite-1 为 4,000 tokens。
rerank-2 的 query 长度上限为 4,000 tokens；rerank-2-lite 与 rerank-1 为 2,000 tokens；rerank-lite-1 为 1,000 tokens。
rerank-2 要求 query token 数与任一单文档 token 数之和不超过 16,000；rerank-2-lite 与 rerank-1 为 8,000；rerank-lite-1 为 4,000。
单次请求的文档数不得超过 1,000 篇。
rerank-2 与 rerank-2-lite 的总 token 预算（query tokens × 文档数 + 所有文档 token 之和）不超过 600K。
rerank-2 被官方描述为面向质量优化的第二代通用 reranker，支持多语言（multilingual support）。
官方推荐在 embedding 检索（或 BM25/TF-IDF 等词法检索）得到的 top 候选之上再施加 reranker 以精化排序。
